questions.stem: A right-angled triangle has a hypotenuse of 8 cm and one angle of 30 degrees. What is the exact length of the side opposite the 30-degree angle?
questions.explanation: O = H x sin(30) = 8 x (1/2) = 4 cm. Remember sin(30) = 1/2, not sqrt(3)/2.

questions.stem: What is the exact value of sin(30) + cos(60) + tan(45)?
Find the exact area of an equilateral triangle with side length 6 cm.
questions.explanation: Height = 6 x sin(60) = 6 x (sqrt(3)/2) = 3 sqrt(3). Area = (1/2) x 6 x 3 sqrt(3) = 9 sqrt(3) cm squared.

questions.stem: A right-angled triangle has a hypotenuse of 10 cm and one angle of 45 degrees. What is the exact length of each shorter side?
questions.explanation: Each shorter side = H x sin(45) = 10 x (1/sqrt(2)) = 10/sqrt(2) = 10 sqrt(2)/2 = 5 sqrt(2) cm.

questions.stem: What is the exact value of tan(60) x cos(30)?
questions.explanation: tan(60) = sqrt(3), cos(30) = sqrt(3)/2. Product = sqrt(3) x sqrt(3)/2 = 3/2.
